main.description: The secrets dev.knotless.putSecret left for a repository, by name. Its owner, and an admin who joined the organization that owns it, sees every one, with the value only of those sealed to it, as a runner that logs in as the owner or that admin. A runner sees those sealed to it, with the sealed value, to open with its key; anyone else, none. Requires a service token from the caller's PDS, audience the appview's DID, for this method, or the appview's own pages' login, as their writes take it.

repo.description: The repository's key, as its dev.knotless.repo record holds it.

refPattern.description: Refs a secret reaches: a ref, or a prefix ending in *.

pattern.description: As a trigger's `refs` match: refs/heads/main, or refs/tags/v*.

secret.description: A secret left for a repository with one runner.

key.description: The runner's key it is sealed to, a did:key.

name.description: The secret's name, as a workflow's `secrets` lists it.

refs.description: The refs whose pushes it reaches; absent for every push.

runner.description: The runner it is sealed to.

sealed.description: The sealed value: only to the runner it is sealed to.
